name: Portal to Bur
title: Portal to Bur
summary: The Portal to Bur, summoned by Prince Borelean Strathelar in the 2007 live event so players could rescue Asheron from the Falatacot. The kit shows it on a snowy summit (z 404): the portal on a small brick platform, three pedestals with Magical Orbs (north, east, west) and four pitched-roof brick towers (19.4 m) at the cardinal points, the Portal Servitor nearby, steep snow and ice slopes falling away.

landmarks.name: Four towers
landmarks.note: 0x01001106 at N/E/S/W, 24 m from the portal.

insertNote: Kept the batch's route position (chapter ch2).

shots.standingOrder: Climb a 36 deg clockwise corkscrew round the summit at 48 m to 58 m radius, 45 m to 70 m above the portal platform, staying above the four tower roofs; nothing within 26 m.
shots.notes: The Portal to Bur on its snow peak (z 404): Prince Borelean Strathelar's portal stands on a brick platform ringed by three pedestals with glowing magical orbs, four pitched-roof brick towers guarding it at the cardinal points. The helix rises over the summit from the south-east, the 0.42 late-morning sun in the south-east behind the camera. shots.standingOrder: Look up at the Portal to Bur from 2.6 m above the summit 11 m north-east, between the northern and eastern pedestals, creeping 1 m closer; keep 4 m from the orbs, never fade the portal.
